ud4.8:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
ud4.8:1.3: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā sakkato hoti garukato hoti mānito pūjito apacito lābhī cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ ,
ud4.8:1.4: bhikkhusaṃgho pi sakkato hoti . . . pe . . . parikkhārānaṃ.
ud4.8:1.5: aññatitthiyā pana paribbājakā asakkatā honti (comp. II.4) . . . pe . . . parikkhārānaṃ.
ud4.8:2.1: atha kho te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā bhagavato sakkāraṃ asahamānā bhikkhusaṃghassa ca yena Sundarī paribbājikā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā Sundariṃ paribbājikaṃ etad avocuṃ:
ud4.8:2.2: ussahasi bhagini nātīnam atthaṃ kātun ti.
ud4.8:2.5: jīvitam pi me pariccattaṃ ñātīnaṃ atthāyā 'ti.
ud4.8:3.1: tena hi bhagini abhikkhanaṃ Jetavanaṃ gacchāhī 'ti.
ud4.8:3.2: evam ayyā 'ti kho Sundarī paribbājikā tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ paṭissutvā abhikkhanaṃ Jetavanam agamāsi.
ud4.8:4.2: vodiṭṭhā kho Sundarī paribbājikā bahujanena abhikkhaṇaṃ Jetavanaṃ āgacchatī 'ti,
ud4.8:4.3: atha naṃ jīvitā voropetvā tatth' eva Jetavanassa parikhāya kūpe nikhaṇitvā yena rājā Pasenadi Kosalo ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā rājānaṃ Pasenadiṃ Kosalaṃ etad avocuṃ:
ud4.8:4.4: yā sā mahārāja Sundarī paribbājikā sā no na dassatī 'ti.
ud4.8:5.1: atha kho te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā Jetavanaṃ vicinitvā yathānikkhittaṃ parikhākūpā uddharitvā mañcakaṃ āropetvā Sāvatthiṃ pavesetvā rathiyāya rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ upasaṅkamitvā manusse ujjhāpesuṃ:
ud4.8:6.2: alajjino ime samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā dussīlā pāpadhammā musāvādino abrahmacārino.
ud4.8:6.3: ime hi nāma dhammacārino samacārino brahmacārino saccavādino sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā paṭijānissanti.
ud4.8:6.4: n' atthi imesaṃ sāmaññaṃ, n' atthi imesaṃ brāhmaññaṃ,
ud4.8:6.5: naṭṭhaṃ imesaṃ sāmaññaṃ, naṭṭhaṃ imesaṃ brāhmaññaṃ,
ud4.8:6.6: kuto imesaṃ sāmaññaṃ, kuto imesaṃ brāhmaññaṃ,
ud4.8:6.7: apagatā ime sāmaññā, apagatā ime brāhmaññā.
ud4.8:6.8: kathañ hi nāma puriso purisakiccaṃ karitvā itthiṃ jīvitā voropessatī 'ti.
ud4.8:7.1: tena kho pana samayena Sāvatthiyaṃ manussā bhikkhū disvā asabbhāhi pharusāhi vācāhi akkosanti paribhāsanti rosenti vihesenti :
ud4.8:9.1: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃsu,
ud4.8:9.2: Sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
ud4.8:11.1: n' eso bhikkhave saddo ciraṃ bhavissati sattāhaṃ eva bhavissati sattāhassa accayena antaradhāyissati.
ud4.8:11.2: tena hi bhikkhave ye manussā bhikkhū disvā . . . pe . . . vihesanti, te tumhe imāya gāthāya paṭicodetha:
ud4.8:12.2: yo c' āpi katvā na karomī 'ti c' āha
ud4.8:12.3: ubho pi te pecca samā bhavanti
ud4.8:13.1: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā ye manussā bhikkhū disvā . . . vihesenti , te imāya gāthāya paṭicodenti:
ud4.8:15.2: akārakā ime samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā, na yimehi kataṃ sapant' ime samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā 'ti.
ud4.8:15.3: n' eva so saddo ciraṃ ahosi, sattāham eva saddo ahosi, sattāhassa accayena antaradhāyi.
ud4.8:16.1: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
ud4.8:17.2: yāva subhāsitaṃ kho c' idaṃ bhante bhagavatā:
ud4.8:17.3: n' eso bhikkhave saddo ciraṃ bhavissati, sattāhassa accayena antaradhāyissatī 'ti.
ud4.8:18.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
